source: WoG 3.58f official distribution linked by Acid Cave
analysis: Static Hopper dossiers plus bounded LLVM objdump of the unrecognized switch arm; Windows binary was not executed.

observations.fact: R requires three parameters; -1 owner uses current-player helper 0x7104f0; resulting owner must be 0..7.
Resource7 uses the separate dword table at 0x27e9354 indexed by player.
Resources0..6 treat getter result -1 as an error sentinel before invoking the generic operand operation.
Setter writes the full dword through the resolved resource pointer, then refreshes. No clamp is present in this setter.

derivedImplementation: Source resource7 binds by mithril identifier rather than an assumed native index.
Closed replicated mutation preserves the signed source word without SetResources clamping other resources.
Native interface receives the ordinary resource-change notification.
limitations: Hopper did not associate the R switch arm with its dispatcher body; the address-bounded objdump listing supplements those dossiers.
This does not establish original runtime behavior for every operation or every invalid input.
OW:D/A/K, mutations of I, and other OW operations are not implemented in this lot.
